title: docs(spec): the sha-less objectui line citations move to their liveness rows
body:
Fixes #23434

Clause-②: no

The last part of issue 23434, under claim 6184826965. It moves the remainder listed in landing record 6184152953 under ruling 6165388570 (letter C) item 1 ("The published spec source carries no renderer citation after this") into the matching liveness notes, in item 2's spelling. The two live citations with no matching note stay as named exceptions (the "stays: no ledger row" rows below); the seat's ACCEPT on this PR keeps `Fixes` on that reading. It also carries residual 2 of the post-hoc review 6184726608. Ruling 6181034096 (Q2 → A) keeps retirement history in place, and this PR applies that test to two of the listed lines.

## What changes

Every edit to `packages/spec/src` is to a comment. The ledger notes take the moved records as `objectui @SHA FILE#SYMBOL`, each read at objectui `b9814b334` (the `.objectui-sha` pin on this base).

| source line(s) on base `8d05456cbe` | record | disposition | ledger row |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data/field.zod.ts:1816` | slider `step` reader | moved | `field.json` `step` |
| `data/field.zod.ts:1835` | vector `dimensions` reader | moved | `field.json` `dimensions` |
| `ui/action.zod.ts:966`, `:969`, `:970` (+ `:971`, a `.ts` line) | param-dialog `description` chain | moved; stale claim corrected | `action.json` `description` |
| `system/translation.zod.ts:161` (a `.ts` line, outside the 8 files) | the same chain, on the translation slot | moved; stale claim corrected (bounded in-place fix, below) | `action.json` `description` |
| `ui/bulk-action.zod.ts:81` (+ `:73`, `:76`, `:79`, `.ts` lines) | bulk param `options[]` passthrough | moved; stale claim dropped | `view.json` `list.bulkActionDefs` |
| `ui/i18n-label-resolver.ts:136` | the two resolvers' composition order | moved | `page.json` `regions`, entry [2] (`page:tabs` `items[].label`) |
| `ui/view.zod.ts:456`, `:458` (+ `:457`) | row-`id` decoration producers | moved | `view.json` `list.filter` and `list.sort` |
| `ui/view.zod.ts:965` (+ `:967`) | `ViewFilterRule` row `id` | moved | `view.json` `list.filter` |
| `ui/view.zod.ts:1701` | `allowAddTab` reader | moved | `view.json` `list.userFilters` |
| `ui/view.zod.ts:2803` | sort entry row `id` | moved | `view.json` `list.sort` |
| `ui/app.zod.ts:963` | `areas[].order` retirement record | stays: retirement history | none |
| `ui/dashboard.zod.ts:1462` | `widgets[].aria` removal record | stays: retirement history | none |
| `ai/build-progress.zod.ts:100` (+ `:102`) | build-progress phase readers | stays: no ledger row | none |
| `ui/view.zod.ts:5283` (+ `:5284`) | the "pin this view" trace on `ViewItemSchema` | stays: no ledger row | none |

Each moved comment now names its row, in the form PR #23591 used ("read points recorded in `liveness/view.json`, row `list.filter`").

**Residual 2 (review 6184726608).** `view.json` `list.exportOptions` named `ObjectGrid.tsx` by line (`:1596-:1611`, `:1620-:1631`). It now names `objectui @b9814b334 packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx#exportableFormats` (`formats`, `streaming`) and `#handleExport` (`maxRecords`, `includeHeaders`, `fileNamePrefix`, and `streaming` again for the server-stream choice). The note keeps that the first measurement was by line at objectui `origin/main@878140b`.

**Two stale claims, corrected on the move.** These were renderer readings that no longer hold at the pin. Each source comment now states only the contract, and the ledger records the current reading:
- `ui/action.zod.ts` and `system/translation.zod.ts` said the description resolver falls back from `objects.{object}._actions.{action}.description` to `globalActions.{action}.description`. At objectui `b9814b334`, `useObjectLabel.ts#actionSuffixes` reads one address only: the object's for an action with a key object, the global one for an action without (objectui#11439 retired the chain). That matches the spec's own `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts#actionTranslationNode`. The `action.json` `description` evidence carried the same stale chain and now reads by symbol.
- `ui/bulk-action.zod.ts` said objectui's bulk-param option TYPE is closed (a label/value pair only). At `b9814b334`, `objectql.ts#BulkActionParam` types an option entry open, with an index signature. The passthrough reasoning does not depend on the type, and it stays.

## The four items listed without a ledger row (6184152953): one reading each

| item | reading | reason |
|---|---|---|
| `ai/build-progress.zod.ts`, objectui `dda8f3815` (the same record as line 100 above) | stays | `BuildProgressFrame` is a stream frame, not a registered metadata type, so no ledger file covers it. The module's own "Liveness watch" section says so, and it keeps each reading beside its surface by design. A row would mean enrolling the frame in `check-liveness.mts`'s `SPEC_ONLY_SCHEMAS`, as `query` and `realtime_subscription` were, each by its own card with a census. That widens what the gate governs, which is not this card's to decide. |
| `api/dataset-selection.test.ts` (objectui `@98178b2`) | stays | Writer provenance for test specimens: the request shapes five objectui call sites build. This is the class 6184152953 keeps for the 30 pin-test citations. `DatasetSelection` is a query request, and `dataset.json` governs `DatasetSchema` only. |
| `system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts:578-579` | stays | The comment records that a row is impossible: planting `config` in `view.json` failed `check:liveness` as an ORPHAN. The walk stops at the `view` union's container arm (`check-liveness.mts#shapeOf`). It is a dated census of seven keys, not a renderer read point. |
| the `VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS` census (`ui/view.zod.ts`, and `ui/view-console-round-trip-keys.test.ts:19`, `:42`) | stays | The same walk boundary: the round-trip keys live on the `viewItem` and `listOverlay` arms, which have no rows. The record is also the symbol ADR-0005 appendix (c) cites (`docs/adr/0005-metadata-customization-overlay.md`, `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts#VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS`). It names no renderer file. |

## The recount, on `origin/main` `8d05456cbe` (re-taken on `9a6f790a38`, which changes none of the six source files: the same 16)

- Instrument: `git grep -nE '[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.tsx:[0-9]+' -- 'packages/spec/src/**' ':!*.test.ts'`. It gives 38 lines. 22 of them are in `conversions/registry.ts`, `migrations/**` and `registry.ts.template`, which are group R and stay. That leaves **16** in the 8 named files: build-progress 1, field 2, action 3, app 1, bulk-action 1, dashboard 1, i18n-label-resolver 1, view 6. Landing record 6184152953 says 17, but its own per-file list sums to 16.
- Control: the same instrument at HEAD still counts the 22 group-R lines (22 → 22), so its zeros elsewhere are readings.
- The records also cite objectui by `.ts:NNN`. A wider instrument (objectui package paths with `:NNN`, any `.ts`/`.tsx`) adds 8 lines on the same records. It also finds one record outside the 8 files, `system/translation.zod.ts:161`. In-repo `.ts:NNN` citations (`dataset-compiler.ts`, `memory-driver.ts`, `kernel-base.ts`, `middleware.ts`) and the cloud one in `agent.zod.ts` are not renderer citations, and they stay.
- After this PR: 16 → **4** `.tsx:NNN` lines (the four "stays" rows above), and 21 → **5** on the wide instrument.

## Bounded in-place fix, outside the claim's file surface

`system/translation.zod.ts:161` is not in claim 6184826965's file surface. I fixed it here because all four of os-dev's bounded in-place conditions hold:
1. It is the same defect class: a sha-less objectui `file:line` in published spec source.
2. The fix is mechanical, in the shape this card fixed.
3. No open PR touches the file. I read the file lists of all 12 open non-release PRs.
4. The gate family is the same; no new verification surface.

The claim's file surface needs this file added. The seat records that.

## Verification

Head `5596717198` merges `origin/main` `9a6f790a38` into this PR's one change commit, `f7160d1f2e`. Head `023b160afe` follows it with one changeset-only commit (the headline now names which read points moved and which stay); no build or test input changed. The merge was clean, and it brought PR #23600 and PR #23601, which touch `packages/spec`. After the merge, `git diff --stat origin/main HEAD` is still these 11 files (+62 / -54). Every reading below was taken on `5596717198` after the merge:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` through `os-verify-lock.sh`: VERDICT command-exit 0. After it, `git status` was clean, so the build wrote no tracked file.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` (vitest `--project local`; no `test:repo`) through the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0. "Test Files 678 passed (678) · Tests 20741 passed | 1 todo (20742)".
- Comment-only check. Each of the 6 changed `.ts` files was parsed with TypeScript at `origin/main` and at head and printed with comments removed. 6 of 6 are identical. The control: a one-character string-literal mutation printed differently, and a comment-only mutation printed the same.
- Ledger anchors. The 21 new `objectui @SHA FILE#SYMBOL` anchors were checked with `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs#symbolSegmentResolution` against `git show SHA:FILE` in an objectui clone. 21 of 21 are declarations, and 0 are unresolved. The `containers.tsx` anchors on the edited `page.json` line are declarations too. Negative control: one bogus path and two bogus symbols gave 3 of 3 unresolved. The clone was read only, and its `git status` stayed empty.
- `check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors`, with `OBJECTUI_CHECKOUT` set to that clone and without it: the same verdict, exit 0 both times. "4888 anchors … 3 cross-repo … 0 NEW line anchors on tracked targets survive (199 citations name no tracked file …)". None of the 3 cross-repo anchors is `objectui:`, so the variable had nothing to judge in spec source.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) derived 81 commands. The list is the same as on the pre-merge head. Each command was run with its exit code captured before any pipe, then reconciled with `--ran`: "81 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 78 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED".
  - 77 exited 0. They include `check:liveness`, `check:docs`, `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:empty-state`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` and lint's `check:doc-formula-expressions` (after building `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/sdui-parser` and `@objectstack/lint`).
  - 3 exited 3, prerequisite not met: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n-walk-parity` and `check:lean-entry-closure`. They read the built output of packages this diff does not touch (every dist, `packages/cli/dist`, `packages/objectql/dist`). This is a declared narrowing, and CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs them.
  - 1 exited 1, and it comes from the base: `check:platform-checklist`. It reports the same 7 ABSENT SYMBOL findings PR #23591 reported (`areas/access-security.json` 5, `attachments-storage.json` 1, `search.json` 1), plus that area's anchor floor (27 against 28). This PR touches none of those paths.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date".
- Census on head: 4 `.tsx:NNN` lines and 5 on the wide instrument, with group R still at 22.

## Acceptance notes

- **Census class, stated.** This PR moves the `file:line` spelling: the third spelling PR #23591 left. Symbol-only mentions of renderer components in prose stay, as they did in PRs #23589 to #23591. Examples are "objectui's `ActionParamDialog`" and "the console's filter builder". They name no file or line, and a pin hop cannot falsify them.
- **Observed, not filed (carrier: none).** Existing ledger rows this card did not move into still cite objectui by line. Examples: `app.json` `navigation.order` (`NavigationRenderer.tsx:1154, :913` at objectui `@940ba24`; at `b9814b334` the sort is `packages/layout/src/navOrder.ts#byNavOrder`), `translation.json` `objects` (`useObjectLabel.ts:397-400`), `view.json` `list.kanban`, `list.emptyState` and `list.aria`. Ruling item 2 governs the spelling of moved records. Respelling the ledger's older entries is not a defect class, and this card does not claim it.
- **Observed, not filed.** Three census sentences say "at the `.objectui-sha` pin" without naming the tree: `VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS`, the switcher row-state docblock in `ui/view.zod.ts`, and `view-console-round-trip-keys.test.ts`. No gate ties them to the pin any more, so a pin hop forces nothing. Naming the tree the #20456 census used would make them dated readings.
- **Retirement test, applied.** `ui/app.zod.ts:963` sits in the `areas[].order` retirement docblock (retired 17.0.0), and `ui/dashboard.zod.ts:1462` in the `widgets[].aria` removal record (call graph closed 2026-08-04). Both are parts of retirement records, so ruling 6181034096 keeps them as dated history. The `app.zod.ts` line no longer points at the sort at the pin. As history it is not re-measured.
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed.
- No label written: a published file changes and a patch changeset is present, so `skip-changeset` does not apply.
